falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the primary risk index closes at a new 63-day high and at least 3% above its current 20-day high, while blowoff score prints at or below 35 and pattern similarity to mini_top_2019_jun falls below 40%.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The mini-top analog has failed and the tape has resolved into a breakout, so UNKNOWN plus HOLD is wrong and a risk-on continuation call is required.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the primary risk index closes at least 5% below its trailing 20-day high, VIX closes above 22 for three consecutive sessions, blowoff score rises above 75, and pattern similarity to mini_top_2019_jun rises above 90%.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The June 2019 mini-top pattern has confirmed into a downside break, so UNKNOWN plus HOLD is wrong and a risk-off call is required.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days high-yield OAS widens by 50 basis points or more from the current level and the VIX/VIX3M ratio closes above 1.0 for five consecutive sessions.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Credit and volatility have entered a stress regime rather than an unresolved hold tape, so the UNKNOWN verdict is falsified in favor of confirmed risk-off.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
